scenarios.question: Hi. Where can I get free groceries this Saturday? I do not have a car.

before.answer: Wrenfield Pantry gave out free groceries at Brightwater Hall on a recent Saturday morning. I don't have information confirming that it's open this Saturday, so please check before you go. Brightwater Hall is one block from the nearest bus stop, so you can get there without a car. The pantry doesn't ask for your name or any paperwork, and it helps to bring your own bags.

after.answer:
This Saturday (October 31), Wrenfield Pantry is giving out free groceries from 10 AM to 1 PM in the Alder Branch Library community room. Its usual hall, Brightwater Hall, is closed, and the pantry will be at the library every Saturday through December 31. Nobody has to show ID. The library has a step-free entrance and an elevator up to the community room.

I don't have any bus or transit information for the library, so I can't tell you which stop is closest.

**Checked:** The pantry coordinator's update (conversation 794dc0ab-2c26-483d-988e-ea08fbb5ae73, written October 14, 2026) moved the pantry from Brightwater Hall to the library. That replaces the older directory listing for Brightwater Hall.
